Fileby file.

Every name below is a real file or command in the repo. The C11 core has no file I/O, no clock, no socket, no allocation; the Python twin is stdlib-only and must produce the same bytes.

Freeze — on the QNX 8.0 target

  1. 01CaptureKernel trace runs into a circular buffer.
    tracelogger -d1 -E -r -S 16M
  2. 02TriggerProcess termination detected (/proc scan, 50 ms).
    target/hook/ham_hook.c · target/hook/dumper_hook.c · declic_watch.c
  3. 03DéclicStops the trace, fingerprints it, writes the manifest.
    target/declic/declic_qnx.c · declic_portable.c · sha256_portable.c
  4. 04Convert.kev → RKV1 inside the guest, byte-identical to Python.
    target/declic/kev_rkv1.c
  5. 05Archive RDA1Six correlated sections, one file.
    trace + pidin + slog2 + core + manifest + rkv1

Explain — on the host

  1. 06ReadDecodes and checks against the official traceprinter.
    host/replique/kev_reader.py · kev2rkv1.py · tests/differential_traceprinter.sh
  2. 07EventsNormalised REPLIQUE_EV_* events.
    core/src/kev.c · core/src/event.c
  3. 08AutopsyWait-for graph, blocking chain, frozen culprit rule.
    deadlock.c · culprit.c · inversion.c

Replay — on the host

  1. 09ReplayDeterministic scheduler model, FNV-1a 64 hash, --whatif TID=PRIO.
    core/src/sched.c · core/src/replay.c
  2. 10Verdict & renderCanonical lines, one-page report, self-contained SVG.
    verdict.c · report.c · markdown_report.py · view.py

Target: QNX 8.0 guest under QEMU, built with qcc (SDP 8.0). Host: any PC with gcc C11, Python 3.10 and make — make test needs no QNX, no target, no licence.
